name: Silver Bullets adds its extra damage against Undead (#2178)
contract: Silver Bullets 574149 / 574163 read 'Increases the damage of Darkslayer by $s1%, increased by an additional $s2% against Undead' with $s1 = $s2 = 10 / 20 (Spell.dbc 2026-09-17). Effect 0 is a SPELLMOD_DAMAGE percent mod on class mask word2 0x20 (Darkslayer). Effect 1 is a raw aura 112 record with the private selector 20014 and MiscValueB 32 (creature-type mask, Undead = 1 << (6 - 1)), which nothing reads: native aura 168 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_DONE_VERSUS honours the effect's class mask once the selector is in MiscValueB (Unit.cpp:8863, 10808). Darkslayer 681203 is DmgClass 3 and goes through MeleeDamageBonusDone, which multiplies the versus factor into the damage and then applies SPELLMOD_DAMAGE, so an Undead target reads 1.10 x 1.10 = 1.21 (rank 1) and 1.20 x 1.20 = 1.44 (rank 2), a non-Undead 1.10 / 1.20. On main the Undead ratios equal the non-Undead ones. Creature types come from data/sql/base/db_world/creature_template.sql: 201 Brittlebones Skeleton is type 6 (Undead), 36 Harvest Golem type 9 (Mechanical, the control). Dawn Blade 802024 is a family 21 spell outside the mask.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Darkslayer against the Undead without Silver Bullets
Darkslayer against the Mechanical control without Silver Bullets
Dawn Blade against the Undead without Silver Bullets
Rank 1: an additional +10% against Undead, 1.10 x 1.10 (effect 1)
Rank 1 does not touch an unmasked ability
Rank 2: an additional +20% against Undead, 1.20 x 1.20
